records.detail: The Central Bank of Ireland ran a public tender, reference 2022P012, to appoint an investment manager for its own portfolio of equities, and the Irish contract award notice names UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd of 5 Broadgate, London as the contractor, for a contract valued at 10 million euro excluding VAT.
records.source_title: Contract award notice: A contract for the provision of equity investment services for the Central Bank of Ireland (ref 2022P012), eTenders / eu-supply Ireland
records.quote: Name and address of the contractor UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd

records.detail: In an earlier round of the same arrangement, tender reference 2016P038 for Equity Management Services, the Central Bank of Ireland appointed Amundi Asset Management of 90 Boulevard Pasteur, Paris to run its portfolio of equities, for a contract valued at 700,000 euro excluding VAT.
records.source_title: Contract award notice: Equity Management Services, Central Bank of Ireland (ref 2016P038), eTenders / eu-supply Ireland
records.quote: Name and address of the contractor Amundi Asset Management
